sourceClaims.claim: Card with button.svg is a 314 by 230 sheet with a radius-16 base, a 137 by 40 radius-20 blue action affordance, vector illustration geometry, and no embedded raster image
Reports card.svg is a 354 by 810 sheet containing three 314 by 230 radius-16 specimens: two white and one #EEF0F4, each with repeated trailing 18.5 by 18.5 outlined geometry
Cover.svg is an 874 by 400 static vector sheet with white background geometry, six outlined text paths, no filter, and no embedded raster image
radius-16 314 by 230 surfaces and blue/dark neutral paint recur across the card exports but remain composition-specific patterns rather than canonical tokens
the repository verifies the family through source integrity and a mutation-sensitive absence census instead of adding an illustrative runtime component
outlined static exports do not establish click, navigation, loading, media lifecycle, responsive reflow, data-model, or generic Card API semantics

evidence.source-integrity: pass: exact SHA-256 hashes, sheet dimensions, and source-critical represented geometry for all three raw SVGs are locked by the focused Wave 10 test
evidence.structural-contract: pass: repository-wide executable and public-export surfaces contain zero bounded Card composition signatures; fifteen generic card/cover terminology collisions are explicitly classified and a synthetic implementation is rejected
evidence.runtime-browser: not-applicable: the family is source-only and exposes no runtime root, behavior, event, controller, or public API
evidence.accessibility: not-applicable: no production semantics, focus order, keyboard model, or accessible naming contract exists
evidence.focused-visual: not-applicable: raw source artwork is the authority but there is no implemented component or material runtime state to compare in a focused snapshot
evidence.consumer-integration: not-applicable: the census found no live or Data Workspace consumer of the bounded family
evidence.responsive-content-stress: not-applicable: static exports establish no responsive reflow, dynamic content, media lifecycle, loading, empty, or error behavior

staticVisual: pass: direct source inspection records the represented card, report-card, cover, content, illustration, and action-affordance geometry without runtime claims
realInteractionVisual: not-applicable: no executable Card composition exists on which a browser can create a real interaction state
runtimeBehavior: not-applicable: click, navigation, loading, media lifecycle, and data behavior are outside the static source contract

interactionEvidence.manualStateWalk: not-applicable: no executable surface exists; manual review covered all three raw SVGs and the repository-wide absence/terminology census on 2026-08-27

knownLimitations: VERIFIED describes the bounded source/absence audit and does not mean a production Card component exists
the SVGs contain outlined text paths, so literal copy and structured typography properties are not recovered as runtime content contracts
Chromium interaction and screenshot evidence is intentionally inapplicable until a separately approved executable contract exists
